Nora (partnerships): FYI: Platform plans to retire the gateway compat route `/v1/proxy-compat` on 2026-06-20. Need partner notice + migration options.
Ethan (platform): We'll offer two paths: quick SDK patch (minor bump) or a marketplace-hosted shim for slow movers. Plan announce 2026-04-20, rewrites start 2026-05-05, retire 2026-06-20.
Lina (integrations): I'll tag impacted partners (marketplace vendors, OEMs, 2 SI partners). Please post exact header and param diffs so I can make step-by-step docs.
Marco (eng): Tech note: old route added `compat-prefix` to KV keys and accepted `compat_mode=1`. New endpoint uses `X-RW-Compat: true` header. We'll run transparent rewrites for 4 weeks and ship tiny patches (py/js/go).
Nora (partnerships): Draft partner email + tracker. Offer office hours for top 8 partners and an assisted migration lane.
Ethan (platform): I'll own canary dashboard and rollback toggle. Auto-fallback if partner error rate > 10/min during canary.
Lina (integrations): Reached out to CloudVendor and HWInc for early canary. Adding priority tiers to tracker.
HookBot: Reminder: create Jira epic RW-PART-1142 for compat route retirement and partner outreach.
Marco (eng): We'll add smoke tests for KV prefixing and include a short migration curl example in the doc.
Nora (partnerships): Next check-in Wed 2026-04-27 09:00 PT. Link -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-PART-1142 :thumbsup:
